::: {#def-prediction-mse}
#### Mean squared error of predictions

The **mean squared error** of predictions
$\fitted_1, \ldots, \fitted_n$
of observed outcomes $y_1, \ldots, y_n$
is the mean of their squared [prediction errors](#def-prediction-error):

$$\mselr{\fitted} \eqdef \frac{1}{n} \sumin \prederr_i^2.$$
:::
